title.en: We take care of our books

recall.uz: Kitobni toza saqlash haqidagi sheʼrni tinglab oʻqiymiz va kitobni xursand qiladigan ishlarni ajratamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем стихотворение о том, как беречь книгу, и выбираем действия, которые её радуют.
recall.en: We read a poem about keeping a book clean and pick the actions that make the book happy.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: How does the poet treat the book?

explanation.uz: Sheʼr kitobni toza saqlash va ukaga butun qoldirish haqida.
explanation.ru: Стихотворение о том, как беречь книгу и оставить её братишке целой.
explanation.en: The poem is about keeping a book clean and passing it on tidy to a younger sibling.

statement.ru: Поэт хочет оставить книгу братишке чистой.
statement.en: The poet wants to leave the book clean for a younger sibling.

why.en: The poem says “I'll leave it spotless for my little brother.”

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: shoir kitobni ukasiga top-toza qoldiradi.
explanation.ru: Верно: поэт оставит книгу братишке чистой.
explanation.en: True: the poet leaves the book spotless for a sibling.

statement.en: The poet throws the book into water.

why.ru: В стихотворении об этом не сказано.
why.en: The poem says nothing of the sort.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: The poem is only about caring for the book.

prompt.uz: Qaysi ish kitobni xursand qiladi, qaysi biri xafa?
prompt.ru: Какое действие радует книгу, а какое огорчает?
prompt.en: Which action makes the book happy, and which makes it sad?

hint.en: Caring for a book makes it happy.

explanation.uz: Muqovalash, toza varaqlash, tartibli qoʻyish — yaxshi; bukish, chizish, tashlash — yomon.
explanation.ru: Обложка, чистые руки, порядок — хорошо; сгибать, рисовать, бросать — плохо.
explanation.en: Covering, clean hands, neat shelving — good; folding, drawing, dropping — bad.

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the right word!

hint.en: How should you keep a book?

explanation.uz: Kitobni toza tutsang, u uzoq xizmat qiladi.
explanation.ru: Если держать книгу в чистоте, она прослужит долго.
explanation.en: Keep a book clean and it will serve you for a long time.

choices.ru: Книгу нужно беречь и держать в чистоте
choices.en: We should care for books and keep them clean

prompt.en: What does the poem teach us?

hint.en: How does the poet treat the book?

explanation.uz: Sheʼr kitobni asrab, toza saqlashga oʻrgatadi.
explanation.ru: Стихотворение учит беречь книгу и держать её в чистоте.
explanation.en: The poem teaches us to care for books and keep them clean.

openEnd.ru: Что ты сделаешь, если книга порвётся?
openEnd.en: What do you do if your book tears?

prompt.en: Build the sentence from the words!

explanation.ru: «Бережём книгу как зеницу ока» — очень бережно.
explanation.en: “We guard a book like the apple of our eye” — very carefully.

prompt.ru: Выбери слово и вставь в пропуск!
prompt.en: Pick a word and fill each gap!

hint.uz: Kitobni ehtiyot qilsang, u bilim beradi.
hint.en: Care for a book and it gives knowledge.

explanation.uz: «Kitobni avaylab asra, u senga bilim beradi».
explanation.en: “Care for a book and it gives you knowledge.”

clue.en: Which one doesn't belong to a book?

hint.uz: Uchtasi kitobga oid, biri esa asbob.
hint.ru: Три связаны с книгой, одно — инструмент.
hint.en: Three relate to books, one is a tool.

explanation.uz: Bolgʻa — asbob; muqova, varaq, javon esa kitobga oid.
explanation.ru: Молоток — инструмент; обложка, страница, полка — о книге.
explanation.en: A hammer is a tool; cover, page, shelf relate to books.

clue.en: The outer part of a book

prompt.en: Build the word from the letters!

hint.en: You wrap and protect a book with it.
